wkplan-2026-06-22b.title: Week of June 22–28
wkplan-2026-06-22b.review: Calibration done, and it was a strong, consistent week — 6 sessions, every baseline logged, and weight already moving 202.9 → 199 lb (on pace for 189.9 by Aug 14). Lifts looked good — Squat 185×5, Bench 175×5, OHP 105×8, Deadlift 245×4 (felt Great), Row to 135, Pulldown to 130 — so Week 2 now carries suggested weights on every main lift; chase the targets at RPE 8. The fix this week is running: last week 86% of your run time was Zone 3–5 (only 14% easy). So we polarize — Tuesday is your ONE hard 'release' run (push into Zone 4 and enjoy it), and every other run stays genuinely easy (HR ≤150), including a short easy flush jog to finish each lift day. Hard day hard, easy days easy — that's what actually builds the base while protecting your lifting in the deficit.

wkplan-camille-2026-06-22.title: Week of June 22–28 · Starter Week
wkplan-camille-2026-06-22.review: This is your starting point. You're an experienced mover but newer to barbell work, so Week 1 keeps the loads light and the focus on clean technique across a few staple movements. Each lift has a focus cue; pick a weight that feels like a 6–7 out of 10 and stop with a couple reps in the tank. Tuesday is your OrangeTheory-style day — intervals plus core — and Wednesday finishes with mobility. Log everything (even a quick note on how it felt), and next week's plan will progress from what you actually did. Goal trend: a gradual, sustainable move from 135 toward 125 with strength and tone along the way.

0.journal: Adding a timer for after ever set I complete, to see how long it’s taking. But more training data. Each exercise should have something to focus on and suggested weights. Hamstrings cramping when I finished the last set of squats when I was putting plates back, clearly have not done enough squats with weight recently. Copy Log and export smaller, I am hopefully only using that once a week. It shouldn’t be constantly present. Also giving suggested weights, maybe not week one but once there is a bit of calibration on week 2. Auto collapses the part of the workout once I complete it, so by the time I am on core I don’t have to scroll all the way down. Felt pretty good today, first good workout in a while but maybe that’s because I actually had a plan today rather than blindly going into it. Felt good to check off each part of the workout. I think this is a good methodology for progress, just NEED to be consistent about it. Workout took 70 minutes total. Test.

1.journal: I would like for each running day to include a warmup, like stretching and mobility then also be a bit more detailed of a workout rather than just easy have a bit more of a breakdown of what it looks like. Then some stretching at the end as well with a quick 5-10 minute budyweight strength and core workout. I would like running days to have an overall similar structure to the strength days in that regard where the workouts also collapse once completed. also having a Journal attached to the weight tab would be very nice for example last night I ate a bit more and had 2 drinks since a friend was in town so my weight was up and also definitely affected my performance this morning. Feeling very sore from yesterdays legs workout.

extra.desc: Easy run — log distance, time, and how it felt.

2.journal: Bench felt like moderate exertion overall, maybe started too light. OH Press was solid. Barbell felt like a solid progression, challenging maintaining form, last set was probably slightly too heavy for this week. When I scroll down in the app I want the workout progression at the top to maintain at the top rather than the current week/weight header and day of the week. I’d prefer to see the workouts stats and progression. I’d also like the screenshots for Strava to give a more comprehensive view of the workout. Should have started heavier on lat pulldown, didn’t get to a good working weight until the last set. Also when things are a superset there should be separate spaces to enter the weight for each lift. It would be nice if there was a substitute workout button for something similar with different equipment requirements for example the singular ab wheel was being used when it was time for it I ended up getting it today but the small substitute button should give a similar or dissimilar lift if it’s due to physical pain or equipment challenges. Also the timer should stop when I finish the workout so it doesn’t keep going endlessly

3.journal: Felt good enough but I felt like my hear rate was too high for what I was doing.

extra.desc: Easy run — log distance, time, and how it felt.

4.journal: Solid progression on deadlift, felt solid there. Same with goblet squats. It also would be nice to have a recommended rest for each set, also to have a warmup set (unloaded) to check off before starting the real reps. Overall pretty great workout didn’t feel too hard and could have probably had one more set but maybe fine on it , it was about an hour to get through the lift from warmup to cooldown. Overall really enjoying the routine and this was the best a workout has felt in a bit. Maybe I felt great because I had an extra strength C4 pre workout so that could have really gotten me going.

5.journal: Went for 3x8 on pull ups today as I didn3xmax yesterday and didn’t want to just do the same thing. Did bench dips as i don’t think my shoulders are strong enough for 10 parallel bar dips right now. Overall fairly easy workout, I would like Saturday’s to be a bit more of challenging calisthenics in the future. Also for both today and Sunday the run module is not showing up as a normal run, it is weirdly combined with the rest of the workout. So I want to have a common run module and lift module. Also for weight it should go to the next day at midnight the local time, but where I can edit the previous days calories for accurate tracking right now it just goes into a void. There should be some form of an edit button, also probably a way to remove/edit meal options from suggestions.

6.journal: I definitely need to keep stretching and yoga as an essential part of my workout, my previous training phases have had almost no stretching or yoga so this has been very helpful. Need to keep getting loser. Overall I am not feeling very sore for the start of a new training phase, I feel it a little bit but not too significantly, the most sore I was was at the beginning of the week after my first lower body lift. Feeling quite bloated this morning, I ate overall very well yesterday but the one fried meal really did a number. Then I need to get these HEB breakfast burritos out of my diet, I did not realize how high calorie they are for relatively little protein. I think I can find better options. Ok only due to bloating.

0.journal: I finished my work too late to do this work out today.  I have to get settled to get to sleep to wake up early.   Workout looks really good and do not like to miss it.

Got myself a little sunburnt yesterday so that’s taking a bit out of me. Squats felts fine, bar on sunburn was mostly the bad part. First set of RDLs didn’t feel great then second and on felt easy. Started getting a bit warm out on walking lunges then I think I’m at a good weight for those and leg curls for another week. Did both legs clave raise which increased weight on a machine. I just couldn’t get my heart rate down, I kept lowering pace but it wouldn’t come. So I ended with a higher heart rate than I should, I think this was due to heat and dehydration by this point in the workout.

1.journal: Right hip flexor felt a little tight, not at a bad level just very slight discomfort. Great run, I went for the 6x 2 min on 1:30 rest and descended pace from 7:30 to 6:27 miles pretty steadily. I think my watch was capping heart rate because I would only see 176 but I felt like my HR was solidly in the 180s by the last 2 efforts. I’ve been surprised that I don’t really need additional calories before the workout. I had in my mind that I would need to consume calories before working out if I am in this defect but I arguable feel better

2.journal: Bench was good, heavier than last week. I think there should be a progression for each set like 165, 175, 185, 185 to kinda work up in weights rather than straight 180 like it was today. Probably got a little too close to failure on an unspotted set at 185 today. For BO row 135 may be a little heavy for all 4 sets, form started to slip. Same for OH press lifts were a little aggressive by basing this week off of the highest weights from last week. I was totally unable to keep my HR down, I significantly lowered pace from last week so it may just be at the end of the lift where I am fairly gassed that my heart rate is just very high. Even walking it gets up to 130 towards the end

3.journal: Much better HR control today than my post lift runs however I had to lower pace over the last mile to maintain HR goals. Felt very low energy this morning and a harder time getting going and pushing myself through the workout.
